title: My Harem Consists Entirely of Female Demon Villains
titleRomaji: Wo De Hougong Quan Shi Fanpai Monü
titleEnglish: My Harem Consists Entirely of Female Demon Villains
titleNative: 我的后宫全是反派魔女
synopsis: I, the earthling "hero" of this story, crossed over into another world based on a video game and suddenly appeared in a villainous female demon's bed when I arrived. If not for the fact that I had married all the villains in the game before crossing over, I'd have been killed pretty quickly. Now, the villains keep pestering me, asking me to help them rule the world, and vying for my hand in marriage. What am I supposed to do? I'll await your answers online! It's urgent! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Melanco Killing
titleNative: メランコ・キリング
synopsis: Shougo Amane, a con artist belonging to the criminal organization “Chikyou,” reveled in a sense of superiority derived from deceiving and controlling others. Spotting a new target, Shougo moves in to get close. However, it was a trap set by Nagi Ichinose, who has sworn revenge against “Chikyou”—. Shougo makes a proposal that puts him on the brink of death, but—…!? (Source: Young Jump, translated)
